name: Label
intent: Accessible label bound to a form control.

docs.summary: An accessible label bound to a form control. Essential for usability and screen reader support.
usage: Always pair form controls with a Label using htmlFor/id binding. This ensures clicking the label focuses the input and screen readers announce the relationship.

Use the required prop to show an asterisk for required fields. Also mark the input itself required so assistive tech is informed. Keep labels short and put additional guidance in help text below the input.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The text element that names the form control.

parts.name: Required mark
parts.description: Decorative asterisk shown when required prop is true. The control carries the actual semantics.

parts.name: Associated control
parts.description: The form input or control bound via htmlFor/id.

bestPractices.do: Bind the label to its control using htmlFor and id. This ensures clicking the label focuses the input.
bestPractices.dont: Avoid placeholder-only inputs without a visible label. Screen readers and users need persistent labels.

bestPractices.do: Use the required prop on Label and required attribute on Input for accessible required fields.
bestPractices.dont: Avoid typing asterisks manually. Use the required prop for consistent styling.

props.name: required
props.description: Append a required-field asterisk after the label text. The asterisk is decorative (aria-hidden) — also mark the control itself required.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: The id of the form control this label is associated with.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the label.
